subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers adopt and retarget the open conflicting fork PR, or sponsor a narrow same-repository fix in the current Anthropic transport/header paths?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open fork PR uses closing syntax and is not currently mergeable, so cleanup automation should not create a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix
options.body: Create or approve a focused patch in the active Anthropic header-composition path with regression tests for direct OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

options.title: Adopt and retarget the fork PR
options.body: Bring the fork change into the main repository, update it for the current transport implementation, and require focused proof before merge.

options.title: Wait on the fork candidate
options.body: Leave this issue open without a new repair lane until the fork author or a maintainer updates the closing PR into a viable landing path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix
recommendation.body: Create or approve a focused patch in the active Anthropic header-composition path with regression tests for direct OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the current Anthropic transport/header boundary where current blame and recent transport history point most strongly to this owner.
